mapper.sql: select p.paper_id, p.title, p.grade_id, g.grade_name, g.for_evaluation_only, p.professor_id, r.name as professor_name, p.author_position, p.journal_name, p.publish_date, p.doi, p.paper_url, p.abstract_text, p.actual_score, p.status, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark from ms_paper p left join ms_paper_grade g on p.grade_id = g.grade_id left join ms_professor r on p.professor_id = r.professor_id
